About

The June Duo Clash is an independent tournament held by 02_Will and Revenflok. The latter who is part of the LUX clan. It follows a duos format where there are qualifier and semifinal matches and a final of a 2v2 matchup.

Format

  • All teams entered through registration.
  • There are qualifier and semifinal matches which put all registered duos against each other on a map
  • Points are earned through maximum size at any point during a match
  • Final is a 2v2 match where the winner is declared champion
  • Maps:
    • Qualifier:
      • Yellow Sea
      • Middle East
      • Arctic
    • Semi-finals:
      • Lisbon
      • New York
    • Final:
      • Australia
